title: Thai Coconut Mango Sticky Rice Parfait
hookLine: Warm salted coconut sweet rice layered with velvety ripe honey mangoes & toasted sesame.

steps.title: Preheat Oven & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line your baking pan with parchment paper, leaving a slight overhang for effortless lifting. Measure out {rice_mr} and {coco_mr} so everything is ready and at room temperature for a silky, lump-free batter.

steps.title: Steam Sweet Rice Tender
steps.instructionTemplate: Rinse and steam {rice_mr} for 18 minutes until translucent and chewy. Line your baking pan with parchment paper or grease lightly, and make sure {rice_mr} are measured and at room temperature so they blend smoothly.

steps.title: Fold Warm Salted Coconut Cream
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour warm {coco_mr} with a pinch of sea salt over hot rice, cover 10 mins to absorb, and plate with {mango_mr} and extra salted coconut cream.
steps.creatorSecret: A generous pinch of sea salt in the coconut topping makes the mango taste twice as sweet.

steps.title: Cool Completely, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer Thai Coconut Mango Sticky Rice Parfait to a wire cooling rack and let it cool for 15–20 minutes so the interior sets cleanly without crumbling. Lift out using the parchment overhang, garnish as desired, and slice into 4 portions.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 28 mins.
